shiptodefault.title: Default Ship To
shiptodefault.remarks: Indicates whether the specified address is the default shipping address. If only one shipping address is specified for a site, this address is the default ship-to address.

billtocontact.title: Bill to Contact
billtocontact.remarks: The person identified as the contact for billing for the site.

billtodefault.title: Default Bill To
billtodefault.remarks: Indicates whether the specified address is the default billing address. If only one billing address is specified for a site, this address is the default bill-to address.

addresscode.title: Address
addresscode.remarks: The identifier of the address that is associated with the current record.

billto.title: Bill To
billto.remarks: Indicates whether the specified address is to be used for billing.

shiptocontact.title: Ship to Contact
shiptocontact.remarks: The person identified as the contact for shipping for the site.

siteid.title: Site
siteid.remarks: The identifier of the site within the organization.

shipto.title: Ship  To
shipto.remarks: Indicates whether the specified address is to be used for shipping.
